title: The Water Dragon's Bride
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A shoujo fantasy by Rei Toma. Asahi, a young modern-day girl (reviewers estimate five to eight), is pulled into a village resembling old Japan and offered as a sacrifice to a cold Water Dragon God, who keeps her and vows to marry her when she comes of age; the village boy Subaru befriends her while villagers, including his mother, treat her cruelly (ANN Spring 2017 Manga Guide; Viz blurb). The story spans years and explores the god's growing humanity.
life_message: Courage, hope and compassion can survive cruelty, and even a distant god can learn to care.

content.note: Subaru's mother dips Asahi's hand in boiling water; maidens fed 'to the fishes' (ANN); Human Sacrifice tag (MangaUpdates).
'A seemingly endless sequence of horrible things' happen to Asahi (ANN); kidnapping and poison (MangaUpdates).
A god promises to marry a child once grown; reviewers find romance with her unsuitable (ANN); MangaUpdates lists Child Bride and adult-teenager relationship.
Child taken from home, silenced and abused (ANN); Asahi mute for a time (MangaUpdates).
